rules: A generated retail price is not proof that the market will accept the price.
Market validation is required before PROFIT_PASS.
Destination supplier shipping and customer shipping recovery must be known before PROFIT_PASS.
Projected product contribution is not final net profit.
Projected order contribution is not final net profit.
Final profit stays unverified until tax/import, FX, actual payment fees, marketing and realized returns/refunds are attributable.
No automatic Production repricing, publishing, payment activation or supplier order.

integration.sequence: TAXONOMY -> SAFETY -> STOCK/VARIANT -> MARKET PRICE -> SHIPPING -> PROFIT -> STYLE -> SHELF
